purpose: One canonical catalogue of the Gemini free suite's shared facts. Two account profiles project it onto separate credentials; a fact recorded here applies to both, so a quirk measured or fixed for one profile is never re-learned for the other.

captured_from.reanchor_note: P6 found four drifts between this catalogue and the deployed e008aa96: the Gemma temperature omission on two targets, the inverted decision state form, and a retired model still listed as an owner pool candidate. Corrected to the deployed facts, because the deployed bytes are the source of truth: a catalogue that lags them would silently revert a production fix the moment a delta is rendered from it.

scope.included: Google AI Studio chat lanes reachable over the OpenAI-compatibility surface, plus the Google decision lane's physical model.
scope.excluded: Embeddings, TTS, transcription and Live capabilities are separate suites: they have their own wire formats and their own capability contracts, so folding them in would duplicate what already exists.
scope.not_duplicated: Native adapters, endpoint, quirk handling and physical windows are the deployed R6 implementations. This catalogue records them; it does not restate them as code.

shared_quirks.omit_body_fields: The Google OpenAI-compatibility surface rejects the Responses-format fields `store`, `metadata` and `prompt_cache_key` as unknown names (HTTP 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT); a Responses caller sends `store: false` on every call. Dropping them is what lets such a caller reach a Gemini chat target at all.
shared_quirks.unsupported_reasoning_effort: `none` is not a value this surface accepts: it answers 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT while minimal, low, medium and high are served. The refusal is declared so a request carrying `none` is routed to a leg that accepts it instead of being sent to be refused.

models.notes: Default leg of the owner pool and of the NT ladder: the 3.5 Lite is the fastest measured Lite on this project.
Second Lite. Its measured record is not clean (a 503, a grader miss, a >90s timeout, a 24.5s tool-result retry), so its failures cross onward instead of being retried in place.
20-RPD model: the minute budget is what a burst spends, so both are declared.

behaviour.omit_body_fields_why: The three Responses-format names every chat model here omits, plus `temperature`: the surface was measured to answer 400 `Unsupported parameter: temperature`, so a caller-pinned value is dropped instead of relayed. The Gemini Lite targets carry only the three, so this is a fact about these two models, not about the surface.

models.notes: Hosted Gemma writes its chain of thought into the visible message as <thought>…</thought>; the marker is what keeps the monologue out of the caller's text. Below a 512-token reservation it returns no visible text at all, because the thought is charged against the caller's output budget. The 1,300-per-mille admission pad is the measured estimator under-count on this lane.

behaviour.dedicated_client_reason: The 31B answers 503 while it spins up and the lane default cooldown is five seconds, short enough to spend a free-minute budget re-asking a model that is still starting. It therefore needs its own client entry (identical except for failure_cooldown_ms) rather than a cooldown group, which would cool the small model down with the large one.
behaviour.omit_body_fields_why: The three Responses-format names every chat model here omits, plus `temperature`: the surface was measured to answer 400 `Unsupported parameter: temperature`, so a caller-pinned value is dropped instead of relayed. The Gemini Lite targets carry only the three, so this is a fact about these two models, not about the surface.

models.notes: Same Gemma quirks as the 26B, plus the spin-up cooldown.
Serving on its own 20-RPD row, but not a member of the owner pool. Its 600-token thinking floor and the absence of a declared window are facts both profiles must share, whichever pool includes it.

behaviour.state_forms_why: Measured: /v1beta/decisions accepts a bare-string input (HTTP 200) and rejects an untyped object (HTTP 400). The declaration here was inverted, which is what broke google-decision and the smart-decision lane; the deployed manifest records the corrected form and this catalogue follows the deployed bytes.

models.notes: Typed-decision lane. It shares the suite's credential and project but not its chat route policy, so it is catalogued here and projected identically by both profiles as a NON-CHAT lane.
